items.title: Three symbolic properties are UNVERIFIED (11 TIMEOUTs) and must not be read as coverage
items.reason: Recorded at dedup because a TIMEOUT is not a proof and downstream reports must not read silence as coverage (standing rule: symbolic TIMEOUT != proof). (1) End-to-end conservation 'phUSD delivered == amount + stableHalf' TIMED OUT in all 8 configurations, two solvers, bounds from 2**96 down to 2**32 - bound-insensitive, so a narrower domain does not buy a proof. (2) toStableAmount reverts-iff-inexact: the forward exactness direction IS proved; the absence of a spurious revert is not. (3) Overflow parity of the minter's evaluation order is unproven (identical by hand, but that is an argument, not a proof).
items.additionalScopeLimits: Every full-flow proof pins d=6 (or 18) and rate=1e18 concretely; symbolic decimals and symbolic rate were carried only through the pure-arithmetic properties. Full-flow proofs are bounded at amount < 2**96. External dependencies are audit-authored minimal mocks (the real PhusdStableMinter IS used unmodified). The minter's 24h cap, pause flag and enabled flag are left at permissive defaults. Reentrancy is not a symbolic target.
items.action: No finding filed - there is nothing to report, only an absence of proof. Parked so no downstream report claims these areas are verified.
